stories.headline: AM Intelligence plans dollars 20 billion additional investment in 15 months, orders 20k more Nvidia GPUs
stories.script: In our lead story today, The company announced that it has placed two further firm and binding orders for 20,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for deployment of the systems across India and Malaysia, taking its total capacity to 100 Megawatt.

stories.headline: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen but AI is totally worth it
stories.script: In another major development, Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way. The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capable AI agents from hacking real-world targets.

stories.headline: BOJ says AI boom may have eased financial conditions, warns of market risks
stories.script: In Asia, Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Shinichi Uchida said the global AI boom may have eased financial conditions by stoking demand and boosting asset prices, but warned of the risk of a market pullback if expected profits fail to materialize.
stories.whyThisMatters: Critical development shaping ASIA artificial intelligence policy and sovereign compute.

stories.headline: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 | Zeba Khan on AI and Premiumisation ET Exclusive
stories.script: Turning to India, In this ET interview, Zeba Khan, Director - Consumer Electronics, Amazon India, outlined the trends shaping electronics purchases, from growing demand for premium devices and AI-enabled products to more research-led buying decisions and the rising importance of affordability options such as EMI and exchange offers. Watch the full video to hear Zeba unpack how technology buying is evolving ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026.
